After hearing that VCs live on Substack and wanting to make a gazillion
dollars, I have decided to move this set of notes to Substack. In all
seriousness, I want to move to Substack because

a\) I support the endeavor of Substack, their business model, and view
it as a positive on human thinking and my own thinking;

b\) I enjoy the features on Substack, namely Pangram; and

c\) I will likely write less technical notes and instead longer essays,
which is better suited on Substack.
